title: Emoji picker: Refreshed UI and new Atlassian emojis
description:
We've updated the emoji picker across Atlassian apps, including Jira, Confluence, and Jira Service Management, to provide a more modern experience. This refresh includes a new set of Atlassian emojis, making it easier for you to express yourself and collaborate with your team. Open any content where you can use emojis, such as a Jira work item or Confluence page.
	Select the emoji icon in the editor toolbar or type a colon (:) to open the emoji picker.
